title: Introduction To Sociology
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as behaviour which follows the established norms of a group or society."
Conformity is defined as behaviour which follows the established norms of a group or society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a religious organisation that asserts its unique legitimacy but stands apart from society."
A Sect is a religious organisation that asserts its unique legitimacy but stands apart from society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the tools that are necessary in order to have positive social interactions."
Social skills are the tools that are necessary in order to have positive social interactions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an authority which is based on the person's unique personal qualities which enables him to mobilise and lead people."
Charismatic authority is an authority which is based on the person's unique personal qualities which enables him to mobilise and lead people.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to different levels of social organisation in different cultures."
The concept of family refers to different levels of social organisation in different cultures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the stage when the group first comes together."
Forming is the stage when the group first comes together.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very general term referring to a hierarchy of inequality."
Stratification is a very general term referring to a hierarchy of inequality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the ways in which human societies distribute their members in the available social positions."
Ranking is one of the ways in which human societies distribute their members in the available social positions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the result of mutual influence, not simply parallel or simultaneous activity."
Social interaction is the result of mutual influence, not simply parallel or simultaneous activity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a persistent social fact in the modem societies today."
Social stratification is a persistent social fact in the modem societies today.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the systematic study of the groups and societies in which people live, how social structures and cultures are created and maintained or changed, and how they affect our behaviour."
Sociology is the systematic study of the groups and societies in which people live, how social structures and cultures are created and maintained or changed, and how they affect our behaviour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a social group characterised by common residence, economic co-operation and reproduction."
The family is a social group characterised by common residence, economic co-operation and reproduction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the everyday give and take situations that occur."
Social interactions are the everyday give and take situations that occur.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a type of authority which confers on the person the legal right to exercise that authority, for example, the authority of the president of Nigeria is legal -rational."
Legal-rational authority is a type of authority which confers on the person the legal right to exercise that authority, for example, the authority of the president of Nigeria is legal -rational.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a set of beliefs, symbols, and practices (for example, rituals), which is based on the idea of the sacred, and which unites believers into a socio-religious community."
Religion is defined as a set of beliefs, symbols, and practices (for example, rituals), which is based on the idea of the sacred, and which unites believers into a socio-religious community.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is composed of four basic elements: beliefs, rituals, subjective experiences, and community."
The religious frame work is composed of four basic elements: beliefs, rituals, subjective experiences, and community.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most important socializing agents for the child at the very early stages of his development."
Parents are the most important socializing agents for the child at the very early stages of his development.

survey

Informal groups or unofficial groups

consensual element

Important rules

Storming

Human societies

Power

Social organization

cult

Public opinion

Turn-taking

Traditional authority
